title: A Bed of Mud
story_summary: Julian discovers that the death of Samuel Bell may be connected to a hidden historical record about Oakhaven.
opening_hook: A mysterious death at the old docks exposes a hidden connection to Oakhaven's past.
ending_hook: Julian realizes that the strange catalog code is not a random number but a reference to something buried in Oakhaven's history.
tone: dark mystery, slow-burn investigation, atmospheric noir
visual_style: cinematic 1930s-inspired noir, dark interiors, warm practical lighting, restrained camera movement

scenes.dialogue: The Pikes claim this city was built on solid rock.
scenes.visual_description: Sam Bell stands alone near the old docks before dawn, surrounded by dark water, industrial structures, and heavy mist.
scenes.narrative_purpose: Introduce Oakhaven and establish the mysterious atmosphere of the story.
scenes.camera_direction: Slow cinematic push toward Sam Bell. Keep the movement subtle and steady.

scenes.dialogue: But anyone working the docks at four in the morning knows the truth.
scenes.visual_description: Sam Bell looks toward the dark water and abandoned dock structures.
scenes.narrative_purpose: Suggest that the official history of Oakhaven hides a darker truth.
scenes.camera_direction: Slow lateral camera movement while maintaining Sam Bell as the visual focus.
scenes.continuity_notes: Maintain the same pre-dawn lighting and weather conditions as Scene 1.

scenes.dialogue: Slightly tragic case. Samuel Bell, age 69. Case closed.
scenes.visual_description: Sterling examines Samuel Bell's body at the old docks while the surrounding environment remains dark and quiet.
scenes.narrative_purpose: Introduce Sterling and establish the apparent official explanation for Samuel Bell's death.
scenes.camera_direction: Mostly static framing with a subtle controlled push toward Sterling.
scenes.continuity_notes: Maintain the same location and atmospheric conditions established in the previous scenes.

scenes.dialogue: This isn't a heart attack, Ren. It's a catalog code.
scenes.visual_description: Julian studies a mysterious document in his office while Ren stands nearby.
scenes.narrative_purpose: Reveal the first major clue and shift the story from a simple death investigation into a larger mystery.
scenes.camera_direction: Controlled cinematic movement between Julian and the document, avoiding rapid cuts.
scenes.continuity_notes: Transition from the docks to Julian's office as the first major narrative shift.
